title: Verizon Design System / web entry

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Bring design rules and implementation resources together so creators can find the next actionable step.
strategic_value: A shared system entry can help Verizon teams move from principles to reusable components.
demonstration: A laptop shows the web design-system page with a left navigation, a black title banner and two starting points for fundamentals and the core Sketch symbol library.
practical_value: Place conceptual foundations and downloadable implementation resources at the same level of access.

content_islands.name: Device and navigation
content_islands.spec: Center the laptop on white; retain the vertical web navigation at the screen’s left edge.

content_islands.name: System introduction
content_islands.spec: Use a black masthead over the Using the design system for web heading.

content_islands.name: Resource choices
content_islands.spec: Pair the fundamentals card with the core Sketch library card beneath the introduction.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case study says the design system aims to create consistent customer experiences from a single source of truth.
reference_purposes.Application: The screen directs creators to fundamentals and reusable library resources.
